label: Sample JD: Medical Digital Innovation and Product Strategy Lead

resume.summary: Dynamic Application Manager with 10 years of experience in medical imaging, digital healthcare solutions, and data-driven innovation, possessing deep healthcare insights and a wealth of academic achievements. Adept at driving innovation and operational excellence in medical imaging solutions, with expertise in product strategy and project management, successfully implementing complex projects and enhancing product portfolio performance in the Chinese market. Skilled in analytical thinking to develop new business opportunities that meet market demands. Experienced in cross-functional collaboration, leading teams to deliver high-impact clinical applications and solutions. Committed to advancing the healthcare industry through effective communication and customer-centric services. Target framing for Medical Digital Product Strategy / Marketing: emphasizes medical ai, medical digital, medical digital solutions, digital innovation, product strategy through existing medical imaging, healthcare digitalization, AI/ML, and China/APAC implementation evidence.

work.title: Digital Solution Brand Management Manager
details: Planned and strategically developed Bayer's radiology digital market research platform, leveraging Google Cloud to enhance business intelligence and data-driven decision-making.
Led the digital health portfolio strategy for AI-driven medical imaging solutions, integrating cutting-edge technology into preclinical research workflows.
Directed cross-functional projects to ensure digital solutions aligned with global R&D portfolio management goals.

work.title: Senior Application Manager
details: Spearheaded clinical development for Bayer's radiology products, creating disease-based integrated solutions to drive business growth.
Developed innovative business models to provide comprehensive clinical application and scientific services to clients.

Integrated resources to develop clinical digital tools like ROICalc and Thermostat, enhancing client business performance, and created an AI-powered training chatbot using RAG to improve internal communication efficiency.

work.title: Radiology Solution Marketing Associate Manager
details: Drove agile and Scrum operations to optimize global multi-product line imaging workflows (including liver, prostate, etc.).

Coordinated with regional teams across 21 countries to promote the IAWS pilot project, integrating software, medical devices, and pharmaceuticals to improve operational efficiency and product synergy.
Led the A-map clinical project for liver cancer, aligning the product roadmap with the needs of the APAC and China markets.

work.title: Radiology Marketing Associate
details: Responsible for the design and implementation of the MRI brand transformation plan in the APAC market, increasing market share and product penetration.
Developed and implemented marketing strategies tailored to regional market needs, ensuring successful product launches and market expansion.

work.title: Digital Solution Manager (Concurrent)
details: Led the development and execution of the digital platform product roadmap, laying the foundation for future product launches.
Innovated marketing strategies to enhance the company's market position and competitiveness in the digital solutions sector.

work.title: Application Expert
details: Provided internal and external scientific and technical support, initiated innovative projects to drive new business solutions and sales growth.
As a project leader, coordinated multi-stakeholder resources to ensure the successful implementation of preclinical research projects.
Led customer-centric projects to improve service quality and customer relationships.

work.title: Scientific Specialist
details: Collaborated with cross-functional teams to advance translational medicine research from clinical trials to market promotion.
Managed scientific marketing projects, provided technical support, and drove new product development.
Led the implementation of the China WIP project, promoting MRI technology and scientific research advancement.

work.title: Assistant Lecturer
details: Responsible for teaching medical imaging and related courses, and assisting in scientific research.

skills: Medical Physics & Biomedical Engineering: Magnetic resonance physics and molecular imaging, MR sequence application and development, medical imaging post-processing and data analysis.

Software Development: Data science and artificial intelligence (AI algorithms, machine learning, deep learning, CNN/FACN, MONAI, LLM, RAG, LangChain), full-stack programming in R, Python, Matlab, SQL, containerization technologies, cloud computing, and data lakes.
Scientific Writing & Research: Extensive research experience with numerous publications, patents, and code projects.
Market Research & Analysis: Data science insights, market strategy and product roadmap design and development, business-driven and customer-oriented mindset.

Collaboration & Communication: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, excellent communication abilities, clinical and technical orientation, positive customer reputation, and recognition from industry associations.

projects.description: Responsible for the radiology's digital software, especially the radiation dose management software Radimetrics application & further development in China. Providing consultant & service support for Radimetrics to the customers; orchestrated with global digital solution team's strategies for Chinese software business launching & implementation.

projects.title: PV.AI Workflow Initiative & Dataset Building (Primovist AI Project)
